claims.evidence: Photos show Nikon logo on body and pentaprism, but body model number is not legible in any shot, so 'D3400' specifically cannot be confirmed.
Photo 1 shows lens barrel text 'Nikon AF-P DX Nikkor 70-300mm 1:4.5-6.3G ED'.

claims.claim: Working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: No power-on, shutter-fire, autofocus, or screen-display shot/clip provided.
Photos 0, 1, and 2 all show a visible 'Nikon' logo on the body and lens barrel; no Canon branding appears anywhere.

risks.risk: Seller states brand as Canon while photographed item is clearly Nikon-branded.
risks.proof: A clear, well-lit photo of the camera body's nameplate/model badge and a matching lens mount shot confirming brand and model together.
risks.if_unproven: Treat as a listing/description mismatch; price only what is visually confirmed (Nikon body + Nikon 70-300mm lens), and flag for buyer caution.

risks.proof: Close-up of the model label on the body (often near the LCD or base) or a screenshot of camera info menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic/unspecified entry-level Nikon DSLR body, not as the specific D3400.

risks.risk: Shutter actuation count and sensor condition unknown.
risks.proof: Screenshot from shutter-count software (e.g., via USB) or a sample full-resolution test photo showing sensor dust/spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown wear, assume moderate-to-heavy prior use.

risks.risk: Core functionality (autofocus, buttons, LCD, shutter) unverified.
risks.proof: Short video clip powering on the camera, firing shutter, autofocusing with the lens, and showing live LCD display.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-functional / for-parts until proven working.

risks.risk: Missing standard accessories (battery, charger, memory card, lens cap, strap already seen).
risks.proof: A flat-lay photo showing all included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body+lens only, no accessories included.

risks.risk: Lens optical condition (scratches, fungus, haze) not visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements with a light shone through.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having unknown optical flaws, i.e., lower-than-clean-glass value.

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition of screen and underside not shown; grip already shows wear.
risks.proof: Additional photos of LCD screen surface and camera underside/battery door.
risks.if_unproven: Price as heavily used cosmetic grade given visible grip wear.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the body's model nameplate/badge
Video clip of power-on, shutter fire, autofocus, and LCD display
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, memory card, caps)
Close-up photos of front and rear lens glass under light
Photo of LCD screen and camera underside
Clarification/correction from seller on the brand discrepancy (Nikon vs stated Canon)
response.reason: The seller explicitly states the brand is Canon while every photo clearly shows Nikon branding on both body and lens, a direct contradiction that signals a possible copy-pasted or mismatched listing rather than a simple typo.
